description: This PHP file loads and registers the Smarty Autoloader component, ensuring the Smarty framework's classes are autoloaded.

classes.name: Smarty_Autoloader
classes.description: Class responsible for autoloading Smarty classes and managing the autoloading process.

methods.name: register
methods.description: Registers the autoloader with PHP's spl_autoload_register, with an optional parameter to prepend the autoloader.
